# assessment criterion

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:assessmentCriterion`](gmeow-assessmentCriterion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assessmentCriterion>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

The criterion applied. Functional: a 21-axis scoring pass is 21 Assessments (zeros included — a zero is a score, not an absence). Plays the [`observationMethod`](gmeow-observationMethod.md) role without the subproperty axiom ([`claimModality`](gmeow-claimModality.md) pattern). An assessment names a criterion or a rubric, or both (SHACL).
